scope: Current source: independent command-search source states and retries, frozen read scope, stale-result protection, identity-preserving keyboard selection, in-memory query restoration, paged loaded results and exact workflow-definition focus. Existing server matching and access rules remain authoritative. No packaging or release.

baseline.reason: The previous active command implementation silently converted catalog failures to emptiness, coupled source completion, reused background run state, dropped content-only matches, lacked retry/paging/context preservation, and opened only the workflow list.

backend.change: Only the explicit static resource mapping was extended for commands.js; backend search and access logic were not changed.

preliminary_browser_attempts.outcome: Three regression suites passed. The command fixture expected 31 total matches, but the existing server also correctly matched an asset body; corrected the check to count the 31 agent results by type.
Four command flows passed. A test selector for workflow details matched the outer disclosure and nested node identity; narrowed it to the direct definition disclosure.
Seven flows passed. The intended no-result Chinese query also matched real asset text through existing token matching; replaced the fixture query with a unique unmatched token.

Seven flows and the first layout passed. The application CSP correctly rejected injected inline test CSS. Switched the scaling fixture to an intercepted same-origin stylesheet; the application CSP was not changed.

regression_note: Control-routes, reading-interactions and journeys passed in the initial batch. A later frontend adjustment clears abandoned workflow-focus intent on route change; the final UI suite and final command browser suite cover the resulting source. Unaffected passing regression suites were not repeated.
constraints: Run search scans accessible history through the existing endpoint, loads the first 50 matches and offers a complete filtered-history route for additional matches.
Workflow run search still covers only the existing latest-100 API response. Episodic memory search remains in the knowledge library. Both limits are stated in the command dialog.
Search context is held in page memory for the same workspace, tenant and principal; reloading the application resets it.
Closing discards UI ownership of a request; an already-issued GET may still finish.
The command browser scenario performs zero POST requests and uses no external models. Other regression suites perform isolated fixture mutations as part of their existing flows.
New layout checks cover 1024 and 1440 desktop widths, light/dark themes and normal/200% text. Existing regression suites retain their prior wider viewport coverage.
All data used for verification is temporary or synthetic. Existing releases and historical verification records were not rewritten.
